title: Jesus... I Ran The Tap So No One Would Hear Me Cry
topic: she cries in the bathroom with the tap running so her family won't hear

bible.text: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I ran the tap so my family wouldn't hear me cry. Then I came out and ate dinner. 🚿

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You turned the tap up twice. You thought no one was listening.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just don't want to be a burden at home.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Nothing you hide in there is hidden from Me.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then what are the tears even for?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Not for a drain. I keep count of every one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Not one tear went unseen. Not even the quiet ones.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the person who always says "I'm fine". Which "I'm fine" were you hiding today? 👇
